transkript.t: Someone just built a complete Instagram agency
It's 54 AI specialists, each trained for one Instagram job
and the whole thing is open source on GitHub.
You give it your niche and it hands back
a viral reel broken down, 10 ranked hooks
and a script ready to film.
A scout digs through Reddit and trending reels
A researcher studies the top reel frame by frame
so your script is built on a format that already works.
and a script writer turns your favorite
and sends your resource to everyone who asked.
One session and you walk away with a week of content.
Comment Harbor and I'll send you the link.
